description: This file contains transformation logic for converting OpenAI-style embedding requests and responses into Bedrock Amazon Nova format, including handling of synchronous and asynchronous processing. It defines a class that manages parameter mapping, request formatting, response parsing, and async invocation wrapping.

classes.name: AmazonNovaEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: Class that encapsulates the transformation logic from OpenAI embeddings format to Amazon Nova format, handling parameter mapping, request and response transformation, and async invocation wrapping.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params(self)
methods.description: Returns list of OpenAI parameters supported for conversion, e.g., 'dimensions'.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI-style parameters to Nova-specific parameters, e.g., 'dimensions' to 'embedding_dimension'.

methods.name: dict _transform_request( self, input: str, inference_params: dict, async_invoke_route: bool = False, model_id: Optional[str] = None, output_s3_uri: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Converts OpenAI-style input and parameters into a Nova-formatted request, considering async or sync mode, and defaulting modalities if none specified.

methods.name: dict _wrap_async_invoke_request( self, model_input: dict, model_id: str, output_s3_uri: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Wraps a Nova request into the AWS Bedrock async invoke format, including model ID and S3 output configuration.

methods.name: EmbeddingResponse _transform_response( self, response_list: List[dict], model: str )
methods.description: Transforms Nova response format into OpenAI-compatible EmbeddingResponse, aggregating embeddings and tokens.

methods.name: EmbeddingResponse _transform_async_invoke_response( self, response: dict, model: str )
methods.description: Transforms an async invoke response (ARN) into an EmbeddingResponse with hidden parameters indicating the job ID.
